title: Tensorgami: complete public corpus snapshot
author: Henry Shin
timestamp_evidence: Use GitHub's published_at and cryptographically verified release attestation. Manuscript, snapshot and Git commit dates are not substituted for public availability.
scope: Entire current public site and available editable public source, including public historical editions, formalizations, programs, imagery, research records and authoritative links.
changes: Three prose passages are refined: one self-referential sentence is removed from What a Derivative Retains; Fourier, Symmetry, and Reconstruction states its ring-spectrum application directly; and What a Boundary Map Can Prove gives its comparison with Fourier through the mathematical mechanisms themselves. The matching web and PDF editions, derivative Markdown and retained TeX sources are aligned. A direct homepage link makes When a Formal Logarithm Fails easier to find. All mathematics, arguments, examples, notes and substantive cross-references are preserved; the complete formal-logarithm companion and unrelated public content are unchanged.
source_portability: Two companion authoring scripts have local dependency-path fallbacks replaced by portable package/environment resolution in this public source copy. Published site and manuscript/PDF bytes are unchanged.
research_papers: Ten research records and one linked correction retain authoritative external links; externally hosted paper bodies and third-party cited works are not rehosted.
rights: Existing rights notices preserved; all rights reserved unless individual files state otherwise.
limits: Identifies exact disclosed files and their recorded public release time; does not certify originality, correctness, exclusive priority or earlier availability of these exact bytes.
